title: habenaria lutea
intro: Habenaria lutea, commonly known as the yellow spider orchid, is a species of orchid found in tropical regions. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Habenaria lutea include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Habenaria lutea are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential applications.
